The Journal of Invented Results welcomes original research on any topic. The abstract must not exceed 250 words. Provide 4 to 6 keywords below the abstract. The manuscript should be arranged as Introduction, Methods, Results and Discussion. A manuscript may contain at most 8 figures. No more than 3 tables are allowed. The introduction should stay under 600 words. Species names are set in italics. Use SI units throughout the text. Authors are encouraged to deposit data in a public repository. Up to six supplementary files can be uploaded. Submissions are handled by the editorial office within two weeks.
